scope.target_boundary: Local request failure within the declared observation window; no organizational why.

causal_conditions.statement: An uncommitted BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction holds the SQLite write lock while a second connection has a 20 ms busy timeout.

causal_edges.mechanism: The same file and writer statement commit before contention and after releasing the holder; only the held-transaction phase returns SQLITE_BUSY.

reference_explanation: The same file and writer statement commit before contention and after releasing the holder; only the held-transaction phase returns SQLITE_BUSY.

evidence_criteria.proposition: The same file and writer statement commit before contention and after releasing the holder; only the held-transaction phase returns SQLITE_BUSY.

must_preserve_unknown: Production behavior, original incidents and organizational causes are outside this local experiment.

provenance.reference_basis: Actual controlled execution; final scored judgments are separately attributed to AI.
provenance.required_next_step: Independent human review and documented controlled reproduction before sealing or gold use.
notes: One controlled case per distinct executable mechanism; repetitions are correlated.

reference_mechanism.causal_condition: An uncommitted BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction holds the SQLite write lock while a second connection has a 20 ms busy timeout.
reference_mechanism.mechanism: The second connection cannot acquire the database write lock and returns SQLITE_BUSY; rollback of the holder permits the identical write.
reference_mechanism.reference_explanation: The same file and writer statement commit before contention and after releasing the holder; only the held-transaction phase returns SQLITE_BUSY.

未提交事务导致database is locked
limitations: A local SQLite file and two connections are exercised; no remote database or production incident is asserted.
This demonstrates bounded lock contention, not a database deadlock or the business reason the holder transaction was left open.

acquisition_eligibility.rationale: All key rows are query-reachable; neutral ticket contains symptoms and scope only, without observations or interventions.
